(329)'jam dpal rgyud lugs gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs/khyab bdag dang po'i ston pa kun tu bzang*/nges pa lnga ldan rigs lnga gangs

tei:div.tei:p: 'jam dpal rgyud lugs gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ khyab bdag dang po'i ston pa kun tu bzang*/ nges pa lnga ldan rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho/ sgyu 'phrul rol mo rigs gsum sems dpa' la/ gsol ba 'debs so rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud/ sems nyid spros bral 'jam dpal ye shes sems/ gzung 'jin gnyis med don dam ji lta dang*/ tha snyad kun rdzob ma 'dres ji snyed pa'i/ mkhyen gnyis ye shes 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rigs can drwa ma lnga/ dga' rab shrī seng ha rgyal po ja/ rig 'jin rnam brgyad padma thod phreng rtsal/ gsol ba 'debs so rig 'jin brda yi brgyud/ sems nyid spros bral 'jam dpal ye shes sems/ tshangs pa'i me tog rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga/ grub pa'i dbang phyug gter ston brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'jam dpal grub pa mi pham chos kyi rje/ gsol ba 'debs so gang zag snyan khung brgyud/ sems nyid spros bral 'jam dpal ye shes sems/ rig stong (330)gdod ma'i mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ rnam kun mchog ldan lha mo dbyangs can ma/ mkha' khyab zhing gi rgyal dang de sras kyi/ spro dang bsdu ba'i byed po ye shes sems/ gsaul ba 'debs so lhag pa'i lha mchog dgongs/ sems nyid spros bral 'jam dpal ye shes sems/ gnas yul zhing gi bdag po mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung ba'i dregs pa can/ khyad par 'jigs byed las kyi gshin rje la/ gsol ba 'debs so ma sring dam tshig can/ sems nyid spros bral 'jam dpal ye shes sems/ gzung 'jin gnyis med don dam ji lta dang*/ tha snyad kun rdzob la 'dres ji snyed pa'i/ mkhyen gnyis ye shes 'char ba byin gyis rlobs/ ces pa'ang shākya'i dge tshul spobs pa brtsegs pas bskul ngor sngags btsun zil gnon dgyes pa rtsal zhes 'bod pas bris pa dge'o//
